description: This Java class defines MutationResult, a generic result object used within a persistence framework to handle mutation events, encapsulating command, event data, response headers, and state flags for creation/deletion.

classes.name: MutationResult
classes.description: A final class representing the result of a mutation operation, parameterized by event type, containing command details, event to persist, response headers, and flags for created/deleted states.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a ResultVisitor and calls its onMutation method to handle this MutationResult.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MutationResult object, including command, event, response headers, and state flags.
